name.ja: ねこぶそう 並盛り

ja: 可愛い ねこには「ぶそう」をさせよう―。新感覚「ねこ」Hobby現る。
• ねこ原型師×ねこ好きモデラーのコラボレーション!
• 「ねこ」フィギュアに「ジャケット」を着せ「ぶそう」パーツを装備させて楽しもう。
• 「ねこ」は全長約5cm。ねこ造形作家として活躍中の森口修氏の原型により、表情や毛並み、肉球など、細部に至るまで造形。
• 「ぶそう」はフリーモデラーのフクダカズヤ氏のデザインで、緻密なメカ造形とユニークな合体形態を追求。
• 「ぶそう」は単独でミニメカ状態にも組み替え可能！ジャケットや各ぶそうに搭載された3mmジョイントにより組み合わせは自由自在。
• 〈並盛り〉はA,B,C,Dの４種。Aはエジプト座りねこ「グレー」とランチャーメカのぶそうセット。Bはエジプト座りねこ「シロ」とヘリメカのぶそうセット。Cは香箱座りねこ「茶トラ」とタンクメカのぶそうセット。Dは香箱座りねこ「クロ」とジェットメカのぶそうセット。
en: Let's let the cute cat "buso ". A new sensation " cat" Hobby appears.
• Collaboration between cat sculptor and cat-loving modeler!
• Let's enjoy wearing the "jacket " on the " cat " figure and equipping it with " buso" parts.

• The total length of the "cat" is approximately 5cm. Based on the prototype by Osamu Moriguchi, who is active as a cat sculptor, every detail including facial expressions, fur, and paws has been sculpted.
• "Buso" was designed by freelance modeler Kazuya Fukuda, pursuing precise mechanical modeling and a unique combination form.
• "Buso" can be rearranged into a mini-mecha state by itself! You can freely combine them with the 3mm joints installed on the jacket and each bush.

• 〈Normal size〉 comes in 4 types: A, B, C, and D. A is a set of the Egyptian sitting cat "Gray " and the launcher mechanism. B is a set of the Egyptian sitting cat " Shiro " and a helicopter mechanism. C is a set of Kobako sitting cat " Tea Tora " and a tank mechanism. D is a set of Kobako sitting cat " Kuro" and a jet mechanism.
